verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents a first-party MCP server (/mcp endpoint) that lets MCP-compatible clients (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, etc.) search, query, and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations, directly enabling an agent to query traces/metrics/eval results for debugging. This is backed by an official docs page and confirmed by probe evidence. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the MCP server in practice and a documented general-purpose REST/GraphQL API spec (openapi probes 404) for non-MCP API access.
